title: Named canonical exact degree-zero objects, units and coherence
statement: For abelian categories V, W and X with chosen unbounded derived categories, define obj and map to be the canonical singleFunctor in degree zero, and comparison to be the canonical mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor comparison. For every exact additive F:V→W and η:K→F(M), define unit(F,η)=single(η) followed by the inverse exact-single comparison. Universal(F,η) means this unit gives bijections Hom(M[0],N)→Hom(K[0],D(F)(N)) for every unbounded N. Prove preservation of identities and composition of single maps, compatibility of units with exact-functor composition and specified functor isomorphisms, normalization at the identity functor, and equivalence of Universal with the usual raw single-functor formula. These are the actual canonical constructions, without choices of witnesses. For an essentially small site J and a ring map φ:R→S, scalarObj, scalarUnit and scalarUniversal specialize these actual constructions to sheaves of modules with the site-dependent derived-category data fixed in the general-site context. scalarUniversal_iff proves that the specialized predicate is exactly the original raw Hom-bijection formula. The named scalarWeakSheafify proof is the existing weak sheafification instance for module sheaves on an essentially small site.

source.place: mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor; WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/DerivedCategory/LeftDerivedFunctor/SingleFunctor.lean for natural-isomorphism and composition coherence; mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh for identity

proof.text: Define named irreducible object, morphism and unit functions using the existing single functor and comparison. Package object/map into a functor. Transport the canonical comparison componentwise. The functor equations follow from singleFunctor.map_id and map_comp.

Cancel the exact-single hom isomorphism and apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_hom_app_singleFunctor and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_singleFunctor. Their inverse equations and naturality prove comparison_comp and unit_comp. For the identity, the factorsh equation reduces to the identity complex map; singleMapHomologicalComplex is identity degreewise. This gives unit_id. Finally unfold the generic named functions and use associativity to prove universal_iff.

Define the site-dependent scalar object, scalar unit and universal property in the general essentially-small-site context, using the existing derivedRestrictScalars and IsDerivedBaseChange. Their object and unit are the same canonical generic constructions. Unfold the named specialization and apply universal_iff to obtain scalarUniversal_iff. This avoids repeatedly specializing the large derived-category instance data at a scheme. The public scalarWeakSheafify theorem is HasSheafify.isRightAdjoint, used locally to avoid searching for unrelated decompositions of the right adjoint.
